hints.title: Initialize With A
hints.text: Initialize all n characters as a (value 1), leaving remaining value k minus n to allocate.

hints.title: Greedily Place from Right
hints.text: To make the string lexicographically smallest, place the largest possible values at the end.

hints.title: Add at Most 25 per Position
hints.text: Add up to 25 to positions from right to left until the remaining excess is completely absorbed.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursively testing all combinations from left to right causes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Filling from right to left runs in optimal O(n) time and space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate realizes that maximizing trailing characters minimizes prefix characters.
